subject.title: feat(ui): make the sidebar agent chip body the menu trigger

question: Should the agent chip body permanently become a menu-first trigger instead of directly resuming the active agent's newest conversation and routing offline users to Settings?
rationale: Both behaviors are user-visible interaction contracts, and source review can identify the regression but cannot decide whether removing the established shortcuts is the intended Control UI direction.

options.title: Menu-first with preserved actions
options.body: Keep the larger menu trigger, add an explicit current-agent resume row for single-agent state, retain a clear offline Settings path, and require browser proof.

options.title: Keep direct resume
options.body: Retain the chip body's current resume/offline behavior and improve menu discoverability through a larger or better-labeled secondary control.

options.title: Accept shortcut removal
options.body: Approve the menu-only interaction intentionally after browser proof demonstrates that resume, new-session, pairing, and offline recovery remain discoverable.

recommendation.title: Menu-first with preserved actions
recommendation.body: Keep the larger menu trigger, add an explicit current-agent resume row for single-agent state, retain a clear offline Settings path, and require browser proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history and protected maintainer routing make this contributor the strongest candidate to resolve the Control UI interaction direction.
